_: Climb content pack 'Updraft vents' (owner 2026-10-06 night: Climb content ships as data under game/data/climb/, one pack per run; the owner session wires the loader, CI never edits climb.gd). Units are the tower's px like climb.gd (36 px = 1 m, +y up, x 0..960). scripts/games/climb_updraft.gd reads this file: plan(n, plats) picks the platforms of band n that get a vent, build(root, vents) draws them (grated tile, four dust streaks, a low hum), step_vy(...) bends gravity for a figure in a lit column, `pose` is the Stick3D pose_request while lifted (stick3d_glide.gd). tools/probe_updraft.gd checks the beat, the apex and the pose.
name: Updraft vents

vent._: radius: half-width of the column (px). height: how far above the tile the lift reaches (px, 6 m). gravity: gravity scale inside a lit column. lift: steady rise (px/s, 2.2 m/s). beat: seconds for one on/off cycle of a pair. tile: grate width (px). streaks: dust emitters. hum_hz: fan tone.

pieces._: From band 3, every 4th band: the two widest std platforms (>= min_w px) each get a vent; phases 0 and 0.5 of the beat so one is always lit and the jump has to be timed. Rest bands have no std platforms and get none.
